https://dev.roost.ai.core_purpose: The site provides intelligent, automated solutions for managing and deploying cloud environments for development and testing, enabling users to streamline workflows and accelerate software delivery processes.
business_requirements: Users must be able to create and manage cloud-based environments tailored for development and testing purposes.
Users must be able to deploy applications to cloud environments with minimal manual configuration.
The system must provide real-time monitoring and insights into the status and performance of deployed environments.
Users must be able to schedule automated environment creation and teardown based on predefined rules or timelines.
Access control must be available to ensure that only authorized users can modify or manage specific environments.
Users must be able to integrate existing CI/CD pipelines with the platform for seamless deployment workflows.
The system must offer options for resource optimization, ensuring cost-effective utilization of cloud infrastructure.
